project_type: Django + Django REST Framework monorepo deployed serverless on Vercel; Supabase PostgreSQL via the Django ORM; React Native (Expo) mobile client; Django-templates staff web portal.
build_system: pip + requirements.txt with exact == pins for the backend. @vercel/python imports a WSGI callable `app` from api/index.py (NO gunicorn). Vercel buildCommand runs the Tailwind CLI then `python manage.py collectstatic --noinput`; functions.includeFiles bundles staticfiles/**, static/dist/**, static/vendor/**, templates/**, components/**. Mobile uses npm in mobile/.
test_framework: Django's built-in test runner (unittest) run with `python manage.py test`. Mobile: npm test (skeleton only this pass).
verification_instructions: Create/activate a Python 3.13 venv, `pip install -r requirements.txt`, then run `python manage.py check` and `python manage.py test` from the repo root OFFLINE (no DATABASE_URL set, so the SQLite default is used; no live Supabase, no live PayMongo, no network). Both must pass. For the web portal, `python manage.py check` must also confirm the example django-component actually renders in a template (a wrong django-components==0.100 loader path must fail the gate). Record the real command output into .agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/verification.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Migrations are generated with `python manage.py makemigrations` (fresh, first-build; NEVER edit an applied migration). `static/dist/app.css` and `staticfiles/` are build artifacts produced by the Tailwind CLI + collectstatic for the deploy bundle; they are git-ignored and not needed for `manage.py test`.
environment_constraints: Python 3.13.14 and Node v25.2.1 are installed. The `npm` PowerShell shim is BLOCKED by the system execution policy (running scripts disabled); invoke `npm.cmd` for the Tailwind build and mobile commands, or run from a shell that permits scripts. The npm/Tailwind build is only needed for the deploy bundle and the component-render check, NOT for `manage.py test`. No live Supabase, no live PayMongo, no network during verification. In production DATABASE_URL must target the Supabase transaction-mode pooler host on port 6543 (not direct 5432, not the session pooler).
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: Django ORM only for app DB access (the SOLE raw-SQL exception is supabase/cron/*.sql); keep business logic in services/models, not views/serializers; add/update tests for ANY change to billing, auth, or permissions; NEVER log PII (names, contact details) or payment details (amounts, PayMongo IDs, card/wallet data); NEVER commit secrets (env vars only); amounts are integer centavos (PHP 100.00 = 10000); timezone Asia/Manila, currency PHP; compile Tailwind at build time (no runtime CDN); do not add React/other JS frameworks to the web portal; mobile uses NativeWind + react-native-reusables + lucide-react-native; do not edit applied migrations; at session end append one entry to PROJECT-LOG.md (append-only, no secrets/PII/payment details).
key_patterns: RBAC is single-sourced in apps/accounts/permissions.py as PURE functions (no request/DRF imports) returning bool; two thin adapters translate to HTTP — a role_required(checker) view decorator/mixin (403 for wrong role, redirect to LOGIN_URL for anonymous) and DRF BasePermission subclasses — both delegate to the same helpers. Anonymous/None user -> False. The PayMongo webhook is the ONLY writer of Payment paid/failed via services.mark_payment_paid/mark_payment_failed (which guard illegal/stale transitions); can_initiate_payment governs intent only and never writes status. Attendance.save() materializes check_in_date = timezone.localdate(check_in_at or now()) so the (member, check_in_date) UniqueConstraint holds for every caller; record_attendance recovers idempotently on IntegrityError by re-querying (member, check_in_date). The webhook idempotency/signature code is BINDING per the Revision 4 appendix (byte-exact signature over t.encode()+b'.'+raw_body keyed by PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET, te in test / li in live selected by payload livemode; get_or_create + always select_for_update re-read + IntegrityError concurrent-insert catch). ALLOWED_HOSTS: CSV env; DEBUG=True falls back to localhost; DEBUG=False with unset ALLOWED_HOSTS raises ImproperlyConfigured at startup. DB flags DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_CURSORS=True and CONN_MAX_AGE=0 are set unconditionally.
relevant_files: AGENTS.md (binding spec: stack, repo layout, modules, RBAC matrix, payments, deployment constraints, env var names, rules)
.agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/design.md (APPROVED Revision 4 design; the final 'Review response log (Revision 4)' appendix is BINDING and overrides earlier assumptions)
.agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/design-review.md (the review the Revision 4 appendix resolves; context only)
.agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/plan.md (ordered 10-item implementation plan; the fallback working document)
PROJECT-LOG.md (append session entry at the end)
directory_structure: Repo root: manage.py, requirements.txt, vercel.json, .python-version, .env.example, .gitignore. profit/ = Django project (settings.py, urls.py, wsgi.py, asgi.py). apps/ (a Python package) holds accounts/ (User, Role, RBAC), membership/ (Module 1: MemberProfile, Enrollment, Attendance, services, staff web views), billing/ (Module 2: Subscription, Payment, WebhookEvent stubs + services + webhooks.py), finance/ (Module 3: TransactionRecord stub + Owner-only dashboard). api/ (plain module, NOT an installed app) holds index.py (Vercel WSGI entry exposing app), urls.py (DRF DefaultRouter at /api/), serializers.py, views.py. templates/, components/ (django-components), static/ (src = Tailwind source, dist = compiled, vendor = HTMX/Alpine/Lucide SVG), staticfiles/ = STATIC_ROOT build output. mobile/ = RN member app. supabase/cron/ = pg_cron SQL. docs/.
